convert_tf_imagegpt_checkpoint: convert a TensorFlow ImageGPT checkpoint to a PyTorch model with specified size and output path
load_tf_weights_in_imagegpt: load TensorFlow checkpoint weights into an ImageGPT PyTorch model
run_imagegpt_tf_to_pytorch_cli: run the ImageGPT TensorFlow to PyTorch conversion CLI with checkpoint path, model size, and output folder
build_imagegpt_pytorch_model: build an ImageGPT PyTorch causal language model from a TensorFlow checkpoint
save_imagegpt_pytorch_weights: save the converted PyTorch ImageGPT model weights and configuration to a folder
